hints.title: Subsegment Complete Elimination
hints.text: Check if an inner subsegment from i + 1 to k collapses to an empty string, allowing s[i] and s[k] to annihilate.

hints.title: Lexicographical String Comparison
hints.text: Evaluate all valid splits, keeping the lexicographically minimal resulting string for each interval dp[i][j].
